content.markdown: The complete block-renderer projection: `node` and `macro_data_driver`; the complete, localized consumer-owned `TemplateSpec` projection in `template`; the macro-level `dynamicArity` contract; exact semantic `treePath`; mode resolution through `childMode`; the optional `childContainsBlock` recursive block capability; and mode-aware `renderChild`. `childContainsBlock` reports whether the selected complete templates anywhere in a child's subtree include block content, allowing specialized foreign-content renderers such as the SVG renderer to fail closed before unsupported recursive block content crosses the SVG boundary.
